comments.body:
May I suggest to make it possible to configure multiple servers? My use case is to have multiple environments (dev, staging, production) on one host and I like to have an instance for each.

I already have built something for a local project but didn't have time to work it out with all options and create a PR for it.

But here's my implementation: https://gist.github.com/RafaelKr/e9ac5850da8b674a92f0bf4bb5bb9b7f

Edit: I'm using systemd environment instead of CLI flags. It feels much cleaner to me as we don't have to concatenate the strings which possibly could lead to Shell Argument Parsing issues when the arguments contain spaces or quotes or similiar.
Edit 4: Sorry, I didn't see the `cli.toGNUCommandLine`. So it's debatable, I don't know what the nixpkgs convention is there.

Edit 2: I made the webroot configurable as in my project I'm exposing mailpit via nginx on a password protected route.

Edit 3: Maybe we want to add some top-level options later to specify defaults, so we may put the options one level deeper. E.g. `services.mailpit.instances.<name>`

ping @leona-ya @RafaelKr 
Just rebased against latest master.
PR should be ready to merge I guess? :)

I think mailpit listens on `0.0.0.0` by default to make it easily usable inside docker. For usage with nix I would suggest switching to the more secure `127.0.0.1` by default. What do you think?
Besides from that it LGTM! :)

Maybe we want to wait for the merge of #334352 and rebase again before merging this PR.

> Maybe we want to wait for the merge of #334352 and rebase again before merging this PR.

This shouldn't give a conflict: `source.nix` isn't touched anymore in this PR.
@RafaelKr done. If you agree, I'd merge :)

This is from GSOC 2026 ideas: https://gsoc-explorer.vercel.app/ideas/nixos-foundation/#migrate-some-nixos-modules-to-modular-services

> [Modular services](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#modular-services)
are a new NixOS feature to reduce evaluation time as more service modules are written, contrasting the historic evaluation time increases as the [central module list](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/nixos/modules/module-list.nix)
increased, while also supporting more flexible usage patterns like multiple instances of a service type on the same host.
> The workflow:
>
> - Pick a NixOS service whose maintainers agree to the pilot project
> - Factor the core of the service into a modular services module, keeping the user-facing options of the NixOS module the same
> - Implement a very basic test for the modular service itself that only tests the functionality of the modular service (typically config file and launch), leaving proper integration tests to the NixOS test

@Ma27 with the instances option this would now be a perfect candidate for a 1:1 port as a modular service, WDYT?

review_comments.body: This seems to be outdated, but as nixpkgs has a quite old version of mailpit it seems correct for now..

Oof I already wondered why how I came up with `database` while hacking on that module 🤦 
I guess I'll do an update of the software then, thanks for catching this.

FYI I already opened https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/324302 for automatic update PRs via @r-ryantm 
Still waiting to get it merged.

Btw I also initiated that the mailpit documentation shows the version in which specific options were added. See https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/328 for more info.
Can be resolved, this PR now updates mailpit and thus `--database` can be used.
